confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Tokyo prices. The price search returned Numbeo-based figures (via Expatica, June 2026) for restaurant meals, cappuccino, draught beer and wine. I converted yen to USD at roughly 150 JPY/USD, which is an assumption and not a searched rate. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices are estimated from the local beer price and one older (2018) guide, not from direct current data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no booking pages or listings inspected, and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tokyo is estimated from its own crowd-sourced price indexes, with accommodation based on general knowledge of Japanese big-city hostel, business-hotel and 3-star pricing.
